edges: Koalas are capable of giving a nasty nip but choose not to.
Koalas are being killed by parasites.
Koalas are being killed by chlamydia epidemics.
Koalas are being killed by a tumor-causing retrovirus.
Koalas can still be seen in most of the places in Australia.
Koalas are capable of ripping open a man's arm with their needle-sharp claws but choose not to.
Koalas are found only in scattered pockets of Southeast Australia.
Koalas may appear healthy one day and could be dead the next.
